emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY (Linear/Vercel Aesthetic)

mono.usage: Data tables, code blocks, metrics values, labels

visual_enhancers.gradients: No generic full-screen gradients. Use localized, blurred colored drop-shadows (colored light effects) behind key charts or hero text. E.g., a massive 200px blur of rgba(99,102,241,0.2) behind the hero.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06) on all cards to define skeletal structure. Use border-b and border-r in grids for a 'Technical/Wireframe' look.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky headers and floating command palettes. Must include backdrop-blur-xl, bg-[#151619]/70, and a 1px solid border-white/10 top border.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Charts and elevated cards must use colored drop shadows (e.g., shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(99,102,241,0.05)]) to create depth without relying on light mode shadows.

component_rules.cards: Flat, rectangular or slightly rounded (rounded-lg max), dense styles. Avoid heavy shadows; rely on borders and subtle background elevation on hover.
component_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded. Primary buttons: bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-200. Secondary: border border-white/10 bg-transparent hover:bg-white/5.
component_rules.tables: Modern, dense. Use JetBrains Mono for numbers. Hover states on rows should slightly elevate background to #1C1D21. Hide outer borders, use thin bottom borders for rows.
component_rules.charts: Recharts with customized tooltips. Tooltips must be glassmorphic with sharp edges. Chart lines/bars must use chart_palette colors.
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn components customized. bg-[#0D0E10] border-white/10 focus:border-brand ring-offset-0 focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-brand.
component_rules.toasts: Use 'sonner' component with dark theme applied. Positioned bottom-right.
component_rules.dropdowns: DO NOT use transparent backgrounds. Must use #151619 background with solid 1px border. Shadcn dropdown-menu.

grids_and_layouts.marketing_page: High density Bento-grid layout for feature showcases. Asymmetrical layout. Generous padding (py-32, gap-8).
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_workspace: Strict grid hierarchy. Compact spacing. Sidebar fixed width (260px). Main content area must utilize CSS grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-4 or gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: Must leave 'breathing room'. Mix col-span-full, col-span-2, col-span-1. Apply subtle grid lines (border-collapse) to container.

motion.transitions: Use specific properties. Avoid 'transition-all'. e.g., transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-300 ease-out.
motion.hover_states: Cards slightly lift (-translate-y-0.5) and border color shifts from white/5 to white/15.
motion.entrances: Framer motion staggered entrances for dashboard widgets and table rows. y: 20 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1.
motion.micro_interactions: Icon rotations on accordion, pulse effects on live data indicators.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA standards. Use #E6E6E7 for body text, never below #8F8F91 for labels.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-dataset-button').

hero_background.description: 3D render abstract digital visualization depicting neural networks and AI technology. Use as a masked background in the hero section with low opacity (10-20%).

feature_abstract_1.description: Green and red network nodes. Use in 'ML & Forecasting' feature card.

libraries.3d_and_visualizations: Recharts for standard dashboards. Consider React Force Graph for 'Data Relationships' or neural network visualizations if required.
libraries.icons: lucide-react (default). Use with absolute strokeWidth of 1.5 for a premium, lightweight feel.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Use standard React Vite setup with .jsx/.js files (not .tsx). Install framer-motion, recharts, sonner.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Use Tailwind CSS. Configure the color palette strictly as defined above in tailwind.config.js.
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Extract Shadcn UI primitives into /components/ui (use .jsx). Modify Shadcn defaults to remove generic gray/white backgrounds and apply the dark theme hex codes.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds where text readability might be compromised.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Apply subtle noise overlays or grain textures via CSS to break digital flatness where appropriate.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
For .js files, ensure all component props and state logic handle defaults gracefully without TypeScript interfaces.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for Dropdowns, Modals, or Selects. Use solid elevated colors (#151619) with a 1px #27272A border.
